title: How to organize the supply cabinet | Home Office
description:
Hold the consumables this office genuinely burns through in a year, and no more.

This is the Supply Cabinet in the Home Office. About 45-75 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
One open pack of each consumable at hand height with its backstock directly behind it, reams of paper on the bottom shelf, min and max written on a card at the front edge of each shelf, and a step stool standing in the corner of the room.

Sort: Bring everything out and line it up on the floor in categories so you can see the true count, because a dozen
Straighten: One open pack of each consumable at hand height, its backstock immediately behind it on the same shelf, so res
Shine: Wipe the shelves and check for a pen that has leaked, a split toner pouch, or the sticky ring under a roll of
Safety: Reams of paper and boxes of envelopes are heavy and they belong on the bottom shelf, not overhead.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
One open plus one spare of anything used monthly, with min and max written on a card at the front of every shelf.
